info.name: Learning Design Facilitator (LDF) — Production Smoke Test
info.description:
Production Postman collection for ideals-ldf.cite.hku.hk (Learning Design Facilitator / LDF).

Setup:
1. Import this collection.
2. Collection → Variables → set username and password (Admin Portal / LDS service account).
3. Run **1. Retrieve Access Token**.
4. Run Health → Info → General Bot → ILO Bot.

Request bodies follow docs/postman/COURSE.json (LD 1490 — Engineering Design sample).

request.description: Production token flow. Uses Admin Portal user DB when ADMIN_PORTAL_URL is set. Body: x-www-form-urlencoded username + password.
No auth. Expect status ok; lds_api.connected when LDS credentials are valid.
Lists general_bot and ilo_bot tasks for LDS UI.

item.name: 2 - LDS Core (COURSE.json bodies)
item.description: Bodies match docs/postman/COURSE.json — LD 1490 Engineering Design sample.

request.description: From COURSE.json → general_bot_request. Required: message, courseInfo.
From COURSE.json → general_bot_handoff_request. May return open_specialist_bot action.
Poll when BOT_RESPONSE_MODE=async and general_bot returned 202 + job_id.
